answer_1.quote: The ultimate goal of open-domain dialog systems is to provide an enjoyable experience to users.
answer_1.outputs: dialog turns, user responses in open-domain conversations

answer_2.quote: Previous research mainly focuses on optimizing automatic dialog evaluation metrics such as BLEU, which models the distance between the system responses and a limited number of references available.

answer_4.quote: Two dialog experts (co-authors of this paper) randomly annotated 134 dialogs and split them evenly into the test set and development set.
answer_4.guideline: The experts labeled turn-level disengaging user responses based on patterns such as complaining about system responses, disliking topics, terminating or changing topics, and ending with non-positive responses.
